Handed to the team · Tracking for an Amazon.nl-placed replacement is not visible in Shopify or ShipBo

Hi Eric,

Not yet, I am sorry. The replacement was bought through the Amazon.nl account rather than sent from our own warehouse, so no tracking is recorded against your order on my side, and I would rather say that than send you a number I cannot stand behind.

The tracking sits with the colleague who holds that account, and I have asked them for it with your pickup point address and the full history attached, so there is nothing for you to gather. They are back at their desks tomorrow from 10am Eastern and the number comes to you here in this thread, so you do not need to wait for it in the meantime.

The delivery itself is still set for Friday 6 November to (address hidden). Bring your name with you when you collect it, and the sender the shop will see is Amazon.nl. Nothing to pay, nothing to send back.

Best regards,
Sarah

It wasn't even near my house.

Waiting for your response.

Hi Eric,

I am sorry. You spent your day looking for a parcel that was never there, and that is on us, not on you. Please stop searching, it is not your job to find it.

I am treating that one as lost. A tracking line that says handed to a neighbour with no neighbour and no parcel is not something I will keep you waiting on. The claim on that delivery is with the colleague who holds the Amazon.nl account right now, together with the tracking, the delivery note and your address, so nothing has to be repeated by you. They are at their desk today and this is in front of them.

What I want for you is a new power supply sent to the pickup point you gave us, De Boekenwurm at (address hidden), so nothing can be dropped at a door or handed to anyone else again. I have asked for exactly that, and the tracking for it comes to you here in this thread as soon as it is placed.

I know how long this has gone on, Eric. I am staying with it until that unit is running.

Best regards,
Sarah

Hi Sarah,

Then it must be delivered by DHL and not a random courier.
They didn't even ring my homebell. I have a video doorbell.
I will wait again for your message how it goes further/

Regards,

Hi Eric,

Noted, and thank you. Your doorbell footage is useful evidence: nobody rang, so nobody delivered. I have added that to the claim so it is not just our word against a tracking line.

The request is with the colleague on the Amazon.nl account now, and it says plainly that the next one goes by DHL to the service point in your street, De Boekenwurm at (address hidden), and not to your door or to a locker. You collect it there with your name, so no courier decision can go wrong again.

You do not need to do anything else. The tracking comes to you here as soon as the new one is placed, and I will keep watching it until that power supply is in your hands.

Sorry again for how long this has dragged, Eric.

Best regards,
Sarah

Hi Eric,

Not a firm date yet, and I would rather tell you that than name a day that slips again.

Your replacement is on our books as its own order, Shop····, going from our Rotterdam warehouse to your home address, free of charge. The stock was delivered there on 6 November, but the warehouse has not booked it in against your shipment yet, so the shipment is still sitting on hold for stock. That is the only thing standing between you and the parcel.

I have put it in front of the team this morning, with the delivery proof and your shipment number, so it can be checked in and released. They are at their desks from 10am Eastern today, and the moment it ships you get the tracking by email on that order, and from me here as well.

Sorry for yet another wait, Eric. I am staying on this one.

Best regards,
Sarah
